summary:
The top-bar fold Adam named is already identical in both apps. All seven fold rules in Na__UiFeature__Styles__AppHeader__.css match, and both apps toggle the same body class (na-layout-editor--active) in ModeController Enter and Leave. TV has not touched the fold, veil CSS or LoadingVeil since commit bef15277 on 20-Sep.

Two things still make the experience differ. First, TV v2.158.0's five-tab strip (TabStrip 2.0.0: 3D Model, Drawings menu, Specification, Document Register, Design Statements) adds a quiet entry, so the bar also folds when a document tab is pressed from the 3D view. VV still shows one tab per sheet, and its Specification tab only appears once a sheet is open. Second, on VV's first drawing of a session the lazy loader's opaque full-screen cover (z-index 9999) sits over the header and tabs while they fold. TV instead shows an in-host veil under visible tabs after 550 ms.

VV also has no going-in veil of its own. Once document tabs or Dev actions load the editor first, VV's first drawing will open uncovered.

Other gaps:
- The toolbar still has Undo, Redo, Fit, 100% and Notes, which TV removed in Toolbar 1.17.0 and 1.19.0.
- The panels stylesheet lacks TV's additions, including the one-red layer switches from v2.154.0.
- Context-menu flyouts, the Layer row, hover and note tooltips, and the colour palette popover are TV-only.
- VV lacks Open Sans Medium and loads its fonts from Noble Architecture's web host.
- The toast offset differs: 40 px in TV, 96 px in VV.
- On the 3D tab, VV moves the canvas below the tab strip and TV does not.

TV is the side that is behind on the confirm dialog: it has no markup or CSS for it, so every editor confirm falls back to the browser's window.confirm.

Cross-cutting wiring: every ported TV stylesheet needs a home in VV's lazy loader. Most go in the loader's stylesheet list in TV's order. Pre-editor rules go in Styles__Boot, 54 and 55 go in the CSS index, and self-linking feature sheets need nothing.

The shared Whitecardopedia service-worker token is stale (2026-09-18-1). VV v2.70.0 said it had to be bumped and it was not. A ledger row wrongly says VV has no service worker.

The report covers 36 findings, 14 work packages, 11 decisions, the target stylesheet order and a side-by-side acceptance checklist.

findings.title: Header fold CSS and its toggle are already identical (TV unchanged since v2.83.0)
findings.detail: All seven fold rules match: tokens 1000ms / cubic-bezier(0.40,0,0.20,1) / 1000ms one-way hold on the folded rule only; header slides top (never transform) with its shadow to zero; strip welded (top:0, same delay); host snaps to var(--Vale_LayoutTabStripHeight); no reduced-motion branch. Both apps toggle only body.na-layout-editor--active in ModeController Enter/Leave. TV's AppHeader, LoadingOverlays and LoadingVeil last changed in bef15277 (20-Sep). Only comments differ. What differs is WHEN it fires (F02) and what covers it on VV's first open (F04).
findings.evidence: TV AppHeader.css 209-265 vs VV 205-262; TV ModeController 425/700/777 vs VV 284/517/561; git log TV AppHeader: bef15277 2026-09-20
findings.recommendation: No code change. Record 're-verified identical 01-Oct-2026' in the ledger fold section and guard the region with the WP-S10-05 parity gate.

findings.title: TV v2.158 folds the bar on document tabs from the 3D view; VV folds only for drawing tabs
findings.detail: In TV the Specification, Document Register and Design Statements tabs exist from the 3D view; each opens through Na__LeMode__EnterUnder (Enter(null) with Quiet), so the body class lands and the bar folds, with the first sheet laid out quietly underneath and no first-open veil. VV's Specification tab only appears once a sheet is open (TabStrip 1.5.0 line 343), VV has no Register/Statements, and VV OpenSpecification calls Enter(null) with no quiet flag.
findings.evidence: TV TabStrip 2.0.0 344-361; TV ModeController 1.30.0 lines 444, 733, 883-888, 899-969; VV TabStrip 343; VV ModeController 649-650
findings.recommendation: Ship with S10-F03: add Na__LeMode__Quiet and EnterUnder to VV's ModeController and route OpenSpecification (later OpenRegister/OpenStatements) through it, so a document tab folds the bar as in TV and never shows the drawing veil.
findings.vv_adaptation: OpenSpecification reached through the loader facade; quiet entry must also skip the loader's drawing wait.

findings.title: Tab strip: TV 2.0.0 compact strip with a Drawings menu vs VV 1.5.0 tab-per-sheet
findings.detail: TV: 3D Model | Drawings (menu) | Specification | Document Register | Design Statements, shown whenever the project has a sheet. Drawings opens a body-level fixed menu (z 1002): sheets in register order, open row bold and focused, '+ New sheet' on localhost; Escape, outside press or any document change shuts it; Up/Down/Home/End walk rows. Rename and drag are gone; arrows step tabs. VV: one tab per sheet, plus tab, double-click rename, drag reorder, spec tab only while a sheet is open. TV port note: Back-port PENDING to ValeVision3D.
findings.evidence: TV LE/05 TabStrip 2.0.0 (684 lines; PORT NOTE line 60; menu 421-615) vs VV 1.5.0 (456); TV Styles__Main 62-262 vs VV Styles__Boot 29-191; TV devlog v2.158.0 line 1077
findings.recommendation: Take TV 2.0.0 whole and re-apply VV seams: header/console prefix, every import via the Na__LeLoad__ facade, IsAvailable visibility (D-S10-02), async Enter/OpenSpecification. Copy TV's tab-strip CSS region into Styles__Boot (menu rules in, rename rules out). Register/Statements tabs per D-S10-01.
findings.vv_adaptation: Strip must still load before the editor: facade-only imports, rules in Styles__Boot, Layout Mode gate retained until publishing exists.

findings.title: VV first open hides the fold under a full-screen start-up cover; TV shows an in-host veil under visible tabs
findings.detail: TV's first drawing tab mounts 'Your Drawings Are Loading' inside the editor host (.na-le-veil absolute, z 40), after 550 ms and only if still busy, so tabs stay readable and the header folds over it; statuses in Title Case. VV's first press shows Na__LeLoadScreen: the start-up .loading-overlay (fixed, full viewport, z 9999, opaque), 'Loading Layout Editor...', sentence-case statuses, covering header and strip; the body class lands only after the import, so the hold and glide run hidden underneath.
findings.evidence: TV LoadingVeil 1.1.0 lines 103, 315-364; TV LoadingOverlays 283-301; VV LoadingScreen 60-61, 87; VV LoadingOverlays 28-45; VV Loader 144-146, 388-422; TV devlog v2.83 'Title case ... both Adam's'
findings.recommendation: Restyle the loader's loading state as TV's veil (na-le-veil + VV-only --boot modifier at the host's geometry, following the fold), TV headline, Title Case statuses; loader adds na-layout-editor--active at the click so the fold starts as in TV; hand the drawing wait to the ported FirstOpen (immediate). Error state unchanged.
findings.vv_adaptation: Loader keeps its error state (Reload Page / Back to 3D Model) full-screen; only the loading state changes look and geometry.

findings.title: LoadingOverlays veil region: VV lacks TV's in-host base mode
findings.detail: TV defines .na-le-veil as position:absolute; inset:0; z-index:40 (inside the fixed editor host, under the strip) and .na-le-veil--over-model as fixed z 500 for the way back to 3D. VV's .na-le-veil base is the fixed z500 rule, with no --over-model rule. TV's first-open veil and published loading screen both need the in-host base. TV-only 'Model Group Transition Overlay' (design-phase switch) is not drawing; VV-only Load Error State, --opaque and __status--error must stay.
findings.evidence: TV LoadingOverlays 256-339 (veil 283-301) vs VV 269-344 (293-306); VV LoadingVeil line 131 adds --over-model; -w diff 91+/86-
findings.recommendation: Replace VV's veil region with TV's verbatim (comments may name VV). VV's coming-out veil already adds --over-model so it keeps fixed z500. Keep VV-only regions.

findings.title: LoadingVeil: VV has no going-in veil, so after the compact strip VV's first drawing can open uncovered
findings.detail: VV ported only TV's coming-out veil and lent its drawing wait (DrawingSettled) to the lazy loader, so the going-in cover exists only while the loader imports. Once document tabs or Dev actions load the editor first (the normal path after TabStrip 2.0.0), the first drawing tab gets no cover and viewports fill in under the reader - the cold drop TV v2.83 / VV v2.70 were written to remove.
findings.evidence: TV LoadingVeil 1.1.0 exports FirstOpen/ReturnTo3d/Dismiss3d (line 432); VV 1.0.0 exports DrawingSettled/ReturnTo3d/Dismiss3d (326); TV ModeController 733-737 calls FirstOpen
findings.recommendation: Take TV LoadingVeil 1.1.0 whole; keep VV's DrawingSettled export; add an 'immediate' option for a gap-free hand-over from the loader's cover; call FirstOpen from VV Enter when not viewer and not quiet, with viewportCount from the model and PreloadMetrics returning its promise.
findings.vv_adaptation: Keep DrawingSettled export; add immediate option; no PdfFonts so the text-metrics job tracks jsPDF only until the PDF slice ports PdfFonts.

findings.title: Loader facade and ModeController seams needed by the compact strip and the veils
findings.detail: VV's strip reaches the editor only through Na__LayoutEditor__Loader__. The facade lacks VIEW_REGISTER, VIEW_STATEMENT, OpenRegister, OpenStatements, IsSitePlanSheet; CheckNames checks only sheet/spec views. WaitForFirstDrawing checks only Active (line 596), so a quiet document-tab entry would hold the loader screen for an unrequested sheet. Na__LeLoad__GetLabel returns fallbacks until the editor loads, so config labels must equal the strip's fallbacks or tabs rename on load.
findings.evidence: VV Loader GetLabel ~558, CheckNames 284-295, AwaitFirstDrawing 376-384, exports ~718-756; VV ModeController 595-600; label key diff TV 603 vs VV 423
findings.recommendation: Add the facade exports and CheckNames entries; make WaitForFirstDrawing resolve at once when View !== sheet; add TV tab labels (DrawingsTab..., TabStripNote, SitePlanTabTitle) and reword SpecificationTab, TabsNext/PreviousTitle, NoSheets to TV's, keeping fallbacks equal to config values.

findings.title: VV-only Layout Mode switch gates the strip; TV shows it whenever a sheet exists
findings.detail: VV IsAvailable = per-project LayoutEditor__DrawingsData__LayoutModeEnabled AND a sheet, on localhost and live (Dev section 'Enable Layout Mode', labels LayoutModeLabel/Hint/OffNote). TV has no such field; its strip shows when the project has a sheet and it relies on publishing to keep unfinished drawings from clients. Removing VV's gate before VV can publish would show Vale clients unfinished sheets.
findings.evidence: VV ModeController 318-354; VV DevMenu__Controls 1.2.0 log; TV TabStrip 2.0.0 line 316; grep TVM for LayoutModeEnabled = none
findings.recommendation: Keep VV's gate as a recorded divergence until the publishing system (52/53) is ported, then retire it to match TV. Port the compact strip with IsAvailable in place of TV's enabled-and-sheets test.

findings.title: Toolbar: VV keeps Undo, Redo, Fit, 100% and Notes; TV removed them and added 12 controls
findings.detail: TV 1.24.0: name | Select Move Text Leader Dimension Draw Rectangle Circle Arc FloorArea Eyedropper Image [Snap|arrow] Draft Grid GridSnap Ortho Axes hints | Raster Vector | Save Sheets, Download PDF, Share. VV 1.9.0: ...Eyedropper Snap Notes hints | Undo Redo | Fit 100% | Raster | Save, PDF. TV 1.17.0 dropped Notes (Margin Notes panel owns it); 1.19.0 (v2.124.0) dropped Undo/Redo/Fit/zoom while keys and right-click keep them. VV's devlog repeats 1.8.0 and 1.9.0.
findings.evidence: TV Toolbar log 34-150, Mount 423-597; VV Mount 257-361 (Notes 292, Undo/Redo 318-319, Fit/100% 323-324); VV Panel__MarginNotes line 80 'Show notes margin'; TV devlog v2.124.0 line 4193
findings.recommendation: Now: remove Notes, Undo, Redo, Fit, 100% with their imports and listeners (WP-S10-02). Later: take TV 1.24.0 whole once 26/27/28/32/33/37/54/59/66 and VectorQuality exist (WP-S10-12).
findings.vv_adaptation: Slimming has no dependency; full parity waits on the feature modules.

findings.title: Panels stylesheet: TV additions (one-red layer switches, Ref, padlock pair, rangebox, wrapping scale buttons)
findings.detail: The 304-line diff is TV additions plus one moved rule: toggle-group wrap and --tight (1:200 scale row), row inline-check (Hide swings), .na-le-btn--ref, the v2.154.0 rule giving Off, Unlock and Ref one faint red (#9b3b3b on #fbf3f3, border #e8c9c9), rangebox, range-suffix, the Linked Pair padlock region, adv-unit '%'. All are inert until their classes appear; VV colours only the lock today.
findings.evidence: TV 40/Styles__Panels 1,174 lines vs VV 1,000; -w diff 304 lines, TV-only additions; TV devlog v2.154.0 line 1366
findings.recommendation: Take TV's stylesheet verbatim (VV header only). The red Off/Ref states show once Panel__Layers 1.3.0 (eye class) and reference layers arrive from their slices.

findings.title: PanelHost: tab hover hints (1.5.0), colour palette attach (1.6.0), LinkedPairRow (TV 1.2.0)
findings.detail: VV PanelHost 1.4.0 lacks spec.hint as tab hover text, the Colour Palette hand-off for every colour input, and LinkedPairRow/ShowLink (two values and a padlock). TV's left column also has Document Preferences | Specification tabs (ModeController 1.20.0) that need 58__Feature__ScrapbookSpecification; VV's left column has no tabs and its Properties tab has no hint.
findings.evidence: TV PanelHost log 45-61; VV PanelHost log (1.4.0); TV ModeController 521-538; VV ModeController 422; grep VV LinkedPairRow = none
findings.recommendation: Port 1.5.0 hints and LinkedPairRow now and pass TV's hint labels to RegisterTab; add 1.6.0 palette attach with the 54 port and the left-column tabs with the 58 port.

findings.title: Colour palette popover (TV 54) absent; its CSS must load from VV's style index
findings.detail: Every TV colour field opens a white swatch card (Monochrome greys from TV's DataLib SSOT MTE100 series; Dimensions red/blue/green at 150) with the browser mixer opened from a proxy on top, z 1299/1300, closing on pick, outside press, Escape, resize, scroll. VV fields open the bare browser mixer. TV's README requires the stylesheet be imported by the style index, never injected on first use; the palette also serves the 3D tab's Plan Annotations toolbar.
findings.evidence: TVM/54 README behaviour section; TV CSS index line 182; Na__ColourPalette__Styles__ z-index 1300 (line 38); TV devlog v2.126.0, v2.133.0
findings.recommendation: Module port is the 54 slice's; for UI parity import Na__ColourPalette__Styles__.css from VV's 03 CSS index after Styles__Boot (not the loader list), check the grey keys against VV's own DataLib SSOT, decide palette contents (D-S10-10).

findings.title: Sheet context menu: TV flyouts, hints and the Layer row; VV 1.0.0 menu
findings.detail: TV ContextMenu 1.1.0: flyout cards (hover delay, click or right arrow; Escape closes flyout first), muted row hints, 'mixed' ring; CSS .na-le-menu__item--mixed/--hinted/--submenu/--open and .na-le-menu--flyout (z 1201) in Main__Paper. TV SheetTools__ContextMenu 1.7.0 adds the Layer row (LayerMenu 1.0.0), picture rows, rotate 90/reset, Vector tools, Show in Specification, Boolean. VV ContextMenu 1.0.0, SheetTools__ContextMenu 1.2.0.
findings.evidence: TV 30/ContextMenu 1.1.0 log; TV SheetTools__ContextMenu 1.7.0 log; TV Main__Paper menu region 471-657 (menu z 1200 at 534); VV 1.0.0 / 1.2.0
findings.recommendation: Port ContextMenu 1.1.0 and the flyout CSS verbatim, LayerMenu with the layers slice, then the SheetTools__ContextMenu rows whose features exist in VV (WP-S10-11); rows for absent features follow their features.

findings.title: Hover tooltip and bubble-note tooltip (TV-only)
findings.detail: TV SheetTools__HoverTooltip 1.1.0 is one shared fixed tooltip (.na-le-hovertip, z 1000, flips at window edges, bold lead); SheetTools__NoteTooltip 1.0.0 names a specification bubble's note after 500 ms ('EW01  Loggia Arcade'), off on press, wheel, key or drag, never on reference layers. VV has neither, so a bubble on a zoomed sheet shows only its code.
findings.evidence: TV 30/SheetTools__HoverTooltip__.js 1.1.0 and __NoteTooltip__.js 1.0.0 headers; TV Main__Paper hovertip rules (region from 411); TV test Na__Test__BubbleNoteTooltip__.test.mjs
findings.recommendation: Port both modules and the hovertip CSS verbatim with WP-S10-11, wiring PointerDrag's hover pass and SheetTools attach as in TV; port the TV test.

findings.title: Main__Paper stylesheet can only move together with the surface, grips and snap ports
findings.detail: TV Main__Paper (889 vs 632 lines) changes rules VV's JS relies on: stack z-order (paper__stack, depth inline via RefreshStack) replacing VV's fixed slot z-indexes; frames transparent not white; 2 px dashed counter-scaled edges; scoped fade per slot/frame; state-coloured grips; viewport carry and tracking; vector hold; fog image; the osnap marker moved to 28__System__ObjectSnap. Taken alone it would break VV stacking and drop its snap marker.
findings.evidence: -w diff TV/VV LE/10/Styles__Main__Paper__.css (429 diff lines); TV regions 13-126, 658+; VV osnap block 296-361
findings.recommendation: Do not port alone. Take TV's whole file together with SheetSurface 1.13 (stack), Grips, ObjectSnap (+ its CSS), ViewportSnapMove, VectorQuality and DepthFog. Until then copy only the context-menu flyout and hovertip blocks (F13/F14).

findings.title: Stylesheet loading model: every ported TV sheet needs a VV home (index, loader list or self-link)
findings.detail: TV imports all editor CSS from its index at start-up (Surfaces, Main, Paper, DraftMode, DrawingGrid, ObjectSnap, DrawingAxes, Panels, Spec x3, SheetImages, Share, WebViewer last; then ColourPalette, SpellCheck). VV's index imports only Styles__Boot and the loader links 8 sheets on first use. Feature panels (Patterns, VectorTools, Register, Statement, Scrapbooks, FloorAreas) link themselves. A sheet added to VV's index puts editor CSS on every page load; one missing from the loader list ships unstyled.
findings.evidence: TV 03 CSS index 161-190; VV CSS index line 92; VV Loader Na__LeLoad__STYLESHEETS 125-134; TV feature panels use new URL('./...css', import.meta.url)
findings.recommendation: Adopt the report's Appendix A: TV index-imported editor sheets go into Na__LeLoad__STYLESHEETS in TV's order (WebViewer last); pre-editor rules into Styles__Boot; 54 and 55 into VV's CSS index; self-linking sheets need no wiring. Enforce with WP-S10-05.

findings.title: Shared Whitecardopedia service-worker token not bumped since 18-Sep
findings.detail: VV is served under WCP's worker (scope covers /ValeVision3D/; live JS/CSS stale-while-revalidate, guarded only by the token). Token is '2026-09-18-1'. VV v2.70.0 wrote that it 'needs bumping with this release' because a warm cache without SnapshotRenderer's new exports breaks the editor until a second visit; it was not bumped, and v2.71.0 changed shell files too. Loader-linked editor sheets are outside the precache list, so the token is their only guard.
findings.evidence: WCP 62/Whitecardopedia__Pwa__ServiceWorker__Logic__.js line 229 (token), 250 (scope), 260+ (precache); last commit 4a92a943 2026-09-18; VV devlog v2.70.0 lines 194-197
findings.recommendation: Bump the token now and in every package that ships VV shell JS or CSS, with a log line naming the VV version. List the WCP file as a hot file for every UI package.

findings.title: Ledger and port-note errors in this slice
findings.detail: (1) Ledger row ~1189 says VV has no service worker: wrong. (2) The fold section lacks the v2.158 strip as a pending return trip. (3) 'Async confirm dialog' is marked back-ported, but TV has no markup or CSS for it. (4) VV v2.70.0 edits to ModeController and Loader are unlogged and unversioned. (5) VV TabStrip and Toolbar port notes say 'new / Lantern Designer'; VV Toolbar repeats 1.8.0 and 1.9.0. (6) TV LoadingVeil 'Back-port: PENDING' is stale; TV ModeController 'Parity: verbatim' is untrue.
findings.evidence: VV ledger 1188-1189, 1235-1246, 34-37; VV ModeController header (last 1.18.0) and Loader (1.1.0); VV TabStrip 43-48; VV Toolbar 31-57; TV LoadingVeil 52-53; TV ModeController 40-45
findings.recommendation: Apply the report's Appendix B in one ledger and header-only package (WP-S10-08); no code lines change.

findings.title: Confirm dialog: TV falls back to window.confirm for every editor confirm; VV shows a styled modal
findings.detail: Both ship Na__AppUtils__ConfirmDialog 1.0.0, which falls back to native window.confirm when #naConfirmDialog is absent. VV has the markup and .na-confirm-dialog styles; TV has neither. So 11 TV editor modules (selection delete, sheet keyboard, spec transport and actions, register data and transactions, statement data/manager/editor, custom scrapbook, LE Dev) plus the presentation Dev modal show the browser's system dialog. TV is the side to change.
findings.evidence: VV index.html 1322-1333; VV DropdownAndToast 1376-1509; TV ConfirmDialog 85-88, 143-147; grep TV Index.html and TV CSS for naConfirmDialog / na-confirm-dialog = none
findings.recommendation: Back-port VV's markup to TV Index.html and the .na-confirm-dialog region to TV's DropdownAndToast (or a sheet in TV's index); bump TV's PWA token; reopen the ledger row until done (WP-S10-07).

findings.title: 3D canvas and safe frame under the tab strip: VV clears the strip, TV does not
findings.detail: VV's RenderCanvas and export overlay add --Vale_LayoutTabStripHeight to top and subtract it from height (VV v2.21.0 shell rule); TV's start below the header only, so on a project with sheets the 36 px strip covers the top of the 3D view and of the image-export safe frame. TV v2.65.1 already adopted VV's clearance for the nav toolbar, help panel and Tools dropdown. 3D tab only.
findings.evidence: VV RenderCanvas lines 9, 14 vs TV 9, 14; VV ViewportOverlays 29, 32 vs TV 29, 32; VV ledger 1188; VV devlog v2.21.0 lines 4842-4846
findings.recommendation: Decide (D-S10-04). Recommended: back-port VV's two rules to TV after confirming in TV that the safe frame's top is hidden under the strip today.

findings.title: Toast offset differs (TV 40 px, VV 96 px)
findings.detail: Same .na-toast element and look; TV bottom 40 px, VV 96 px ('above the floating navigation toolbar'). On drawing tabs the nav toolbar is hidden in both, so Save Sheets, PDF and layer toasts sit 56 px apart; in the web viewer TV's toast sits over the dock while VV's clears it.
findings.evidence: TV DropdownAndToast line 1264; VV DropdownAndToast line 1250
findings.recommendation: Decide (D-S10-06); recommended one value in both, VV's 96 px (clears the viewer dock), by a TV edit.

findings.title: Fonts: VV lacks Open Sans Medium (500) and loads fonts from Noble Architecture's web host
findings.detail: TV declares 400, 600, 500 (Medium, added 20-Sep for the Statement Writer and asked for by toasts and dropdown headings) and 300, each local-first with the NA CDN second. VV declares 400, 600, 300 only, all from https://www.noble-architecture.com/assets/AD04_..., so weight 500 renders as Regular and VV typography depends on NA's site, against the goal of VV standing on its own file structure.
findings.evidence: TV 03/Na__CoreUi__Styles__Fonts__.css 29-45 (Medium) and two-source src lines; VV Fonts.css lines 12, 23, 34 (NA host only)
findings.recommendation: Add the Medium face; move VV's sources to a Vale-owned location with the NA URL as second source (D-S10-05, WP-S10-09).
findings.vv_adaptation: Vale-owned font path; same faces and weights as TV.

findings.title: Header brand items and the narrow-screen title stay Vale's
findings.detail: Header markup is structurally identical; logo image and alt, title text, favicon, touch icons, manifest and theme colour are brand. At <=600px TV keeps the title at 18 px and VV hides it (VGH logo carries the brand) - TV v2.9.0 records this as deliberate. All shared --Vale_ colour tokens have the same values in both apps (#172b3a), so no colour token in this slice needs re-branding.
findings.evidence: TV Index.html 168-186 vs VV index.html 161-178; TV AppHeader 158-160 vs VV 158-160; TV devlog v2.9.0 line 16218
findings.recommendation: Keep. Record in the ledger as a brand divergence (D-S10-08).

findings.title: VV-only LE/01__Core__Loader and Styles__Boot; tab-strip CSS lives in Boot (VV) vs Styles__Main (TV)
findings.detail: VV's lazy loader (Loader 1.1.0, LoadingScreen 1.0.0, Styles__Boot) has no TV counterpart; TV imports the editor at start-up. Rules needed before the editor loads (strip height, tab strip, Dev sheet list, loading screen) live in Boot. The shared tab-strip rules are byte-identical today apart from TV's v2.158 additions; the location split is permanent and recorded in the ledger.
findings.evidence: drift_all: 01__Core__Loader vv-only x3; TV Styles__Main 62-262 vs VV Styles__Boot 29-191; ledger 1087-1101, 1113-1160
findings.recommendation: Keep the folder and files. Keep Boot's tab-strip region identical to TV Styles__Main's (gate in WP-S10-05); put the Drawings menu rules and the boot veil in Boot.

findings.title: Published drawings loading screen (TV 52, v2.156.0) absent
findings.detail: On every web-viewer drawing tab TV raises an opaque cover at once, fades in '{drawing} is now loading' after 350 ms with a faint status cycling real jobs (Reading the Drawing, Title Block and Notes, Viewport 2 of 3 - Picture...), and lifts when every file, image and font has settled; it reuses na-le-veil classes with inline additions; settings in PubDoc__Loading__Config. VV has no published system. TV's Na__PubDoc__Styles__Main__.css is linked nowhere in TV.
findings.evidence: TVM/52/Na__PubDoc__LoadingScreen__.js 1.0.0 (lines 1-140); Na__PubDoc__Config__.json PubDoc__Loading__Config; TV devlog v2.156.0 line 1214; grep PubDoc__Styles__Main = README only
findings.recommendation: Port verbatim with the publishing slice (it imports nothing) after WP-S10-01; wire from VV's web viewer as in TV; mirror TV in not linking the PubDoc stylesheet (WP-S10-13).

findings.title: Web viewer: TV shows published drawings with a dock Share; VV renders sheets on the reader's device
findings.detail: TV WebViewer 1.2.0 imports the published reader (52) and its loading screen and adds Share in the dock (66, v2.166.0); its stylesheet and touch/drawing/spec sub-modules are header-only diffs. VV 1.1.0 still renders every viewport on the phone. The client-facing difference is the published cover and the absence of on-device rendering.
findings.evidence: TV 80/WebViewer 1.2.0 log and imports (about lines 80-110); VV 1.1.0; drift_all: Styles__WebViewer, __Drawings__, __Spec__, __TouchControls__ header-only
findings.recommendation: Leave to the publishing and sharing slices; this slice only prepares the veil CSS (WP-S10-01) and the loading screen (WP-S10-13) for them.

findings.title: Full screen: TV 76__System__FullscreenMode vs VV 60__Feature__FullScreenMode
findings.detail: TV (v2.8.0): Tools row with an ON/OFF badge driven by fullscreenchange, hidden where element full screen is unsupported, plus a 'Better in Full Screen' invitation on every app open, suppressed on locally served builds (Prompt 1.2.0). decisions_needed.question: VV has no Document Register or Statement Writer yet. Should VV port the compact tab strip before those features land?

decisions_needed.question: VV's per-project 'Enable Layout Mode' switch hides the strip on localhost and the live site until it is turned on. TV shows the strip whenever the project has a sheet. Keep the switch?
